summary.text: Molly Buck is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Ryan Weldon.
Buck previously represented District 41 in the Iowa House from 2023 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Buck won the District 41 seat in the November 2022 general election, defeating Republican Marvis Landon, and succeeded Democrat Jo Oldson.
She was a candidate for re-election in 2024 and lost the general election to Republican Ryan Weldon.
Buck advanced from the Democratic primary for the seat on June 2, 2026, setting up a rematch with Weldon.
